findings.what: Poll alignment vs the 'clean' 8.0 h mark. The poller writes its timestamp before the CLI call and runs every 600 s with ~2 s drift (00:02:53, 00:12:55, ..., 00:43:00Z). The polls around the K2 8.0 h mark (08:02:12Z) should fall at ~07:54:2xZ and ~08:04:3xZ. A K2 completion in (07:54:2x, 08:02:12] is first seen at 08:04:3x. It matters only when d1 <= -0.002 (row 4 vs row 5), so the joint P is ~1-2%, but the fix costs nothing.

findings.what: MECHANICAL SCORE-READ PROCEDURE. (0) Cite table commit 1017c41 < first result. (1) Run python tools/runtime_ledger.py --print and take the rows for K2 ref 56563521 and twin ref 56563534: status, public, and L '(lo, hi]'. (2) Act only when both are COMPLETE or ERROR. Exception: K2 ERROR goes to row 1 at once. (3) Work in thousandths: k = round(1000*K2), w = round(1000*twin); d1 = k-954, d2 = w-953, tk = w-k; clean = K2 COMPLETE and hi <= 8.00 (hi includes the +210 s retry slack; '?' = not clean). (4) First match wins: R1 K2 ERROR; R2 twin COMPLETE and tk >= 2; R3 d1 >= -1; R4 d1 <= -2 and clean; R5 d1 <= -2 and not clean (then d2 <= -2 -> as R4; d2 >= -1 -> keep K2). Outcomes follow the CONTEXT table text verbatim; without the user's OK, [OK] rows use their bracketed text. (5) Log k, w, d1, d2, tk, the L bounds, clean, the row, the F1/F2 refs and any OKs used, then commit. Likely cases: k in {954, 955} and w in {953, 954} -> R3 -> F1 = K2 56563521, F2 = twin 56563534. k = 953 -> d1 = -1 -> R3. k = 954, w = 956 -> R2: F1 = twin, and F2 = K2 only with the OK, else exp52.

findings.what: K2 vs twin on the exp60 lab (IN-SAMPLE, info only). ins35 vs control is the only K2-twin difference; node rows are identical on the dummies. Pooled delta: +0.00648 (adj +0.00015, div_J +0.0633; div TP/FP/FN 16/25/83 -> 25/31/74). Only 15 of 56 clips change an evaluable division: 9 clips get +1 TP each and 6 clips get +1 FP each. 186 of the 201 inserted forks are ignored, and 45 clips hit cap 4. No single clip dominates: the largest jackknife influence is +0.00078, and leave-top-k-out gives +0.0057 / +0.0049 / +0.0042 / +0.0026 for k = 1 / 2 / 3 / 5. Stratified clip bootstrap: 5-95% range +0.0028..+0.0107, P(<0) = 0.001. For 44b6 alone the 5% quantile is 0.0000. The '44b6 +0.0157' in CONTEXT is ONE TP in CONFIRMATION (44b6_d754aa59). 44b6 SELECTION is 0.0000, and 44b6/ALL is +0.0058 from 2 TP / 8 FP over 17 clips. Density quartiles (control nodes/frame; cuts 84.8 / 163.9 / 260.4): Q0 +0.0246 (7 TP / 2 FP), Q1 +0.0028, Q2 -0.0005, Q3 +0.0019. The TP clips have densities 46-75 (7 of 9), 128 and 286. Break-even per event: +1 TP adds 1/N to div_J and +1 FP subtracts J/N, so q* = J/(1+J). That is 0.114 in the lab (J 0.129) and ~0.26 on public (J ~0.35, from probe 26). In-sample dense-half precision is 2/6 = 0.33, not an OOF-safe margin above 0.26. A dense (later-stage) private embryo could therefore give K2 ~= twin, or slightly lower. Private = max(F1, F2), so the twin already covers this.
